review_text: The motor overheats after 10 mins of use, totally not worth the hype. Started smoking in my kitchen!
I love the size but the battery life is garbage. Why doesn't it use USB-C? Also it leaks if you tilt it.
It works okay but the straps dig into my armpits and leave bruises. Needs wider padding.
Returned it. The app connection drops constantly and the vibration is so weak you can't feel it through a jacket.
Armrests break after 2 months. The plastic is so cheap. We need adjustable 4D armrests that are reinforced with metal.
Case hinge is too flimsy, broke in my pocket after a week. Sound is good but the build quality is terrible.
They keep falling out when I run. If they added silicone wing tips it would be a 10/10 product.
Lid leaks when shaken. Ruined my laptop in my backpack. It desperately needs a spill-proof locking mechanism.
